definitions.gloss: end-of-day meeting; closing assembly; wrap-up meeting
definitions.explanation: A brief meeting held at the end of a school day or work shift to review the day's events, share information, and make announcements. Paired with the morning meeting.

examples.japanese: {終礼|しゅうれい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧だ。
examples.english: It's time for the end-of-day meeting.

examples.japanese: ⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{終礼|しゅうれい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{明日|あした}→明日：00501_ashita⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{伝|つた}えた→伝える：01220_tsutaeru⟧。
examples.english: The teacher communicated tomorrow's schedule at the end-of-day assembly.

examples.japanese: ⟦{工場|こうじょう}→工場：01082_koujou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧{終礼|しゅうれい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{安全|あんぜん}→安全：01131_anzen⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}→確認：00158_kakunin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: At the factory, a safety check is conducted at the daily end-of-day meeting.

notes:
Composed of {終|しゅう} (end) and ⟦{礼|れい}→礼：02170_rei⟧ (ceremony, greeting). The counterpart of ⟦{朝礼|ちょうれい}→朝礼：16381_chourei⟧ (morning assembly). In schools, {終礼|しゅうれい} is a brief gathering at the end of the last period where the teacher makes announcements and students report on the day. In workplaces, especially manufacturing and construction, it serves as a daily wrap-up.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {終礼|しゅうれい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧: time for the closing meeting
- {終礼|しゅうれい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{報告|ほうこく}する→報告する：05644_houkokusuru⟧: to report at the closing meeting
- ⟦{朝礼|ちょうれい}→朝礼：16381_chourei⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{終礼|しゅうれい}: morning and closing assemblies

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{朝礼|ちょうれい}→朝礼：16381_chourei⟧: morning assembly — the corresponding start-of-day meeting
- ⟦{帰|かえ}り→帰り：01275_kaeri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{会|かい}→会：27493_kai⟧: closing homeroom — the school-specific term used in many elementary and middle schools
- ⟦ミーティング→ミーティング：05506_miitingu⟧: meeting — general loanword for any meeting
